tools.name: pand
tools.description: Look up a Dutch building by address or BAG id: construction year and use (BAG), measured roof height, ridge and eaves height, roof shape and pitch, footprint dimensions (3DBAG), neighbours, listed monument. Give one: adres or bag_id. Missing data is 'niet vastgesteld'. Answers in Dutch.

tools.name: grond
tools.description: Look up the soil at a Dutch location: nearest BRO cone penetration tests (CPT) with distance and date, the layer summary of the nearest, groundwater (GHG/GLG), GeoTOP, soil map. Give one: adres, x_rd + y_rd, or lat + lon. Indicative. Answers in Dutch.

tools.name: wind
tools.description: Wind zone (I, II, III) and a terrain category proposal (0, II, III) for a Dutch location under the Dutch National Annex of EN 1991-1-4, with the measured building height for an address. Give one: adres, postcode, x_rd + y_rd, or lat + lon. Answers in Dutch.

tools.name: how_to
tools.description: Short guide: the tools, sources, limits, privacy, and where to calculate with this data (statischeberekening.nl /mcp).
